product.tagline: A desktop workspace for developers: a terminal, AI chat, a coding agent and a project and disk audit, in one app for Windows, macOS and Linux.
product.summary: Portal Desktop puts a terminal, an AI chat, a coding agent and tools for keeping a developer machine tidy in one window. Its AI features run through Agent Platform, which you run separately, so the app holds a server address and a token rather than your provider keys. Installers for Windows, macOS and Linux update themselves when a new release is out.

features.title: A terminal with an AI mode
features.detail: A full terminal, plus /ai or Ctrl+Space to ask a question in plain English and have the answer stream into the same window.

features.title: Coder workspace
features.detail: Watch a coding agent take its turns beside the terminal it works in, with its git changes and any sub-agents in view.

features.title: AI chat
features.detail: Chat with any model on your Agent Platform, stop a reply mid-stream, set the system prompt and sampling per chat, and group chats into folders.

features.title: Project audit
features.detail: Finds every project on your drives, shows which are alive, and flags work with unpushed commits or no remote, because that work exists only on that disk.

features.title: Disk Utility
features.detail: Reclaim space taken by projects, developer tools and Docker or Podman resources. Files go to the Recycle Bin rather than being deleted outright.

features.title: GitHub in the app
features.detail: Connect your GitHub account and browse your repositories and issues without leaving the window.

features.title: SDK manager
features.detail: See which SDK managers and language versions are installed on the machine, and manage them from one screen.
